description: Fetch a public web page or PDF with hidden text and exfiltration links removed, plus a prompt-injection report. Use it instead of fetching untrusted URLs yourself; for content you already have, use check_prompt_injection. Returns risk (0-1), level, findings, content and wrapped_text: put wrapped_text in your prompt, not the raw page. Costs US$0.005 in USDC on Base (x402); unreadable pages (robots.txt, login, CAPTCHA, JavaScript-only) return a reason and are not charged.

format.description: Output format of content: markdown (default) keeps links and headings; text is plain text without links

url.description: Public http(s) URL of an HTML page, text file or PDF (up to 5 redirects)

name: read_url
title: Read a web page or PDF safely
